notable_absence.finding: The installation walkthrough uses the Administrator credential throughout every couchbase-cli/cbimport invocation, and never mentions a role or privilege requirement specific to any of the Analytics DDL steps (CREATE ANALYTICS SCOPE, CREATE ANALYTICS COLLECTION). Whether a lesser-privileged role could complete this same workflow is not addressed.

cross_component_finding: This page is a worked, end-to-end demonstration that a shadow collection is not created by a single statement in isolation but by a five-part pipeline crossing two services: (1) couchbase-cli bucket-create/collection-manage provisions a bucket/scope/collection in the Data service, (2) cbimport loads the example JSON into that Data-service collection, (3) CREATE ANALYTICS SCOPE creates the Analytics-side namespace, (4) CREATE ANALYTICS COLLECTION ... ON ... points the Analytics collection at the Data-service collection just populated, and (5) 'The Analytics service ingests the data.' Confirms, concretely, that analytics:shadow-collection genuinely bridges the Data service and the Analytics service rather than being an Analytics-only construct - the ON clause's target ('ON analytics.Commerce.customers') is a Data-service bucket.scope.collection path, not an Analytics-side one.
cross_product_finding: No Capella-specific content appears on this page. The installation steps are couchbase-cli/cbimport-based, which is a Server-side administration path; a Capella equivalent (if any) is not addressed here.
